claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 2 June 1866, p. 1, col. 4 (British Newspaper Archive)
New York Herald, 8 July 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Glad Tidings, Thomson, Cardiff, 36 days, with railway
iron, to Wm & Alfred Nelson. Had light westerly winds and
fogs the whole passage. June 16, lat 46 34, lon 48 18, at noon,
passed close to a very large iceberg; 19th, lat 44 20, lon 49 30,
passed an iceberg and saw several seals; July 2, lat 40 16, lon
69 16, saw steamship Royal Standard, hence for Liverpool.
